description: Use to turn the model's point loads into dispersed patch loads. For new traffic use ec_moving_loads or cs454_moving_loads; for new point loads use civil_loads_supports. Converts the model's point loads (or a coordinate table) into dispersed patch loads with the Point to Patch Convertor's engine and writes them as PATCH_<case> load cases: plate decks get pressures on the plates the patch covers, grillages get UDLs on the members by the lever rule, total force conserved; or, with fill, spread through fill onto a surface the user selects (arch barrel, culvert roof, lower deck) with the depth read from the geometry and any share beyond the surface's edge left out; units converted to the model's. The writer snapshots every row it touches, writes, and reads every item back with a force-equilibrium check. Previews unless apply: true.

acceptBlockers.description: Accept OVERRIDABLE blockers (the plugin's "Write anyway") — only with the user's agreement.

active.description: Elements the patches may load: { groups: [names], useZ, zMin, zMax }.

alphaS.description: Half-angle from vertical through the surfacing, ° (0 is honoured).

b0.description: Contact width across the traffic, m (null = the preset's).

l0.description: Contact length along the traffic, m.

neutralAxisDepth.description: m below the top, for NEUTRAL_AXIS.

presetId.description: Contact area and spread rule (EN 1991-2, UK NA, CS 454, BS 5400, Network Rail…; point_to_patch_read lists them with their clauses).

tc.description: Slab depth, m (apply: default the plate thickness). With fill.enabled: the thickness of the selected surface (default: plate thickness, or a grillage beam's section depth).

fill.description: Disperse onto a selected surface through fill (an arch barrel, a culvert roof, a lower deck — plates or a beam grillage) instead of onto the plane the loads are on. The depth between each load and the surface is read from the model at every point of the spread; whatever falls beyond the surface's edge is LEFT OUT, not redistributed. Leave out (or enabled false) for the plane method.

alphaF.description: Spread half-angle through the fill across traffic, ° (default: the preset's surfacing angle).

depth.description: MANUAL: fill depth under each load, m.

depthMode.description: AUTO: fill depth = load level − surfacing ts − top of the surface. MANUAL: the depth directly under each load is `depth`; the spread still follows the surface's shape.

road.description: AUTO: loads act at their own Z, or at roadLevel.

roadLevel.description: AUTO with road LEVEL: level the loads act at, m.

surfaceGroups.description: Structure groups that make up the surface the loads land on (point_to_patch_read lists the groups).

mode.description: REPLACE rewrites the PATCH_ cases (and removes earlier ones it does not reproduce); ADD writes new ones beside them.

tag.description: Added to the case names: PATCH_<case>_<tag>.

source.description: mode MODEL (default: nodal and beam concentrated loads; lcNames to pick cases, owners, minMagnitude) or MANUAL (manualText: one load per line 'X, Y, P[, Z]' in kN and m; manualCase names the case).

name: point_to_patch_apply
title: Disperse point loads into patch loads
